decisions.statement: A reply's threading is derived from the message replied to rather than stated.
A reply names both the thread it joins and the message replied to.
A subject or a body said both inline and in a file is refused.
`-` names standard input for one flag at most.
A send comes back as the message's id and its thread.
A message once sent is not taken back.
A send that threw after Gmail took the message says the message went.
A body read from a file is carried whole.
A message with no attachment is one plain-text part rather than multipart.
Every send names a subject here or at `--subject-file`.
Every send names a body here or at `--body-file`.

definition: the command sending a composed message from the authenticated mailbox
